findings.text: the DD4 guard is unreachable and the repair it claims does not happen: ids.provenance.node.resize(1) at :117 runs before it, and the DD4 equilibrium IDS has no root provenance node at all (measured on 4.0.0, 4.1.0 and 4.1.1: hasattr(ids, 'provenance') is False, as it also is for pf_active, pulse_schedule and wall), so a DD4 write still raises AttributeError one line earlier; the guard is a no-op, and the fragment's sentence that DD4 'replaced it with a structured reference' misstates the schema, which drops the node rather than replacing the field.

dd_equilibrium_factor states the write-direction rule a second time: nova/imas/pulsedesign.py:30 psi_write_factor already computes convention_transform(source=..., target=...).factor(PSI_LIKE) for the same purpose, and this diff neither calls it nor folds it into the new helper, so a change to what nova's own convention means now has to be made in two places.

this file, and nova/io/sourcemap.py:812, are outside the source node's declared write paths and its brief's Write-only list, which ended 'If a fix needs another file, stop and name it'; the coordinator's dispatch for this review names both files, so the expansion is visible, but the node widened its own fence rather than asking.

every gate log this round added names 'revision ef1643e613c02bc26abfd00a3191e2a86d05ab1f (+ uncommitted gate changes)', so the passing arm cannot be tied to the landed commit 6aaffa08a or to 5326ef004 from the log itself, and the manifest's after_suite (manifest.md:18) is the ten-file arm at fa01f7936, which predates both commits and contains no arm for the new test file or for metadata.py.

item_verdicts.done_when: the source node carries no done_when of its own for these two commits; the manifest's after_suite at line 18 is the ten-file arm at fa01f7936 and predates both, so the change's own arms are the eight final5-head-*.log runs (test_sample_write_convention 5 passed, test_io_sourcemap 22 passed, test_dd_translator 9 passed, test_mastcocos 28 passed, test_database 28 passed 19 skipped, test_equilibrium_reader_cocos 6 passed 1 xfailed, test_internal_cocos_sites 8 passed, test_pulsedesign 5 skipped), every one ending in a bare EXIT=0 line, plus logs/negative-control-write-factor-removed.log at EXIT=1 failing both DD3 tests; no arm reaches nova/imas/metadata.py.

item_verdicts.manifest: read at manifest.md; status complete, nineteen commits listed, checkpoint at line 11 recording the write seam, sourcemap and metadata named openly in the landing line; baseline_suite and after_suite are single-line JSON with ten arms each at zero failures, but after_suite's revision fa01f7936 predates both reviewed commits and negative_control_log at line 22 points at the stale-cache control rather than the write-factor control this round added.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source node's declared write paths at manifest.md:3 and the fence at prompt.txt:92-118 contain neither nova/io/sourcemap.py nor nova/imas/metadata.py, both of which the diff changes, and the brief's Write-only clause ends 'If a fix needs another file, stop and name it'.

justifications.durability: tests/test_sample_write_convention.py:86-103 reddens on the recorded removal of the write factor, but nova/imas/metadata.py:117-121 has no test that fails if reverted, and tests/test_sample_write_convention.py:119-128 multiplies by the writer's own helper, resting on the hard-coded -1.0 assertions at :115-116 for its independence.
justifications.evidence: the eight final5-head-*.log arms are EXIT=0 with zero failures and logs/negative-control-write-factor-removed.log reddens both DD3 tests, but every one of those logs is headed 'revision ef1643e61 (+ uncommitted gate changes)' rather than the landed commit, and no arm exercises nova/imas/metadata.py.
justifications.fit: nova/io/sourcemap.py:812 sits beside dd_equilibrium_convention at :793 and follows its docstring idiom, DEFAULT_DD_VERSION at nova/imas/sample.py:22 is a plain module constant, and no name carries a plan label or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/sample.py:352-353 derive both factors from the version being written and apply them at :363, :403 and :405, and nova/imas/equilibrium.py:580 calls the one vacuum-field owner, but nova/imas/metadata.py:121 cannot reach the DD4 case it names so that part of the goal is only claimed.

justifications.scope_discipline: nova/io/sourcemap.py:812 and nova/imas/metadata.py:114 are outside the declared write paths at manifest.md:3 and outside the brief's Write-only list, which instructed a stop rather than an extra file.
